name: RTI-31
summary: RTI-31 ((–)-2β-carbomethoxy-3β-(4'-chlorophenyl)tropane) is a synthetic analog of cocaine that acts as a stimulant. Semi-synthesis of this compound is dependent upon the availability of cocaine starting material. According to the article, RTI-31 is 64 times the strength of cocaine in terms of its potency to elicit self-administration in monkeys.6 times weaker than RTI-31.

pharmacology.text: RTI-31 ((–)-2β-carbomethoxy-3β-(4'-chlorophenyl)tropane) is a synthetic analog of cocaine that acts as a stimulant. It could therefore be considered within the context as an agonist based therapy for treating cocaine addiction, although it is actually RTI-336 that entered into clinical trials with this in mind. RTI-31 is not an entirely selective DRI in that it also has appreciable SERT and NET blocking affinity.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-31 is cocaine with the ester oxygen removed and a chlorine added to the ring. Those two changes make it bind the dopamine transporter far more tightly and resist being broken down.
fact.zh: RTI-31 是把古柯鹼的酯基氧原子移除，並在環上加一個氯原子。這兩項改變讓它與多巴胺轉運蛋白結合得緊密許多，也更不易被分解。
fact.zhHans: RTI-31 是把古柯碱的酯基氧原子移除，并在环上加一个氯原子。这两项改变让它与多巴胺转运蛋白结合得紧密许多，也更不易被分解。
